name: Захист: перекриття лінії
description:
Attacking is great fun, but defending is also very important in chess. After all, you don't want to lose pieces if you don't have to.

When it comes to defending we often think first of moving away, protecting or capturing. But there are other ways to defend a piece, for example by blocking the attack. You are going to practice with that in this lesson.

Interpose a piece between the attacker and the piece in danger. This way you block the attack and the other can't win any material.


What do you have to do?

Defend a piece by interposing with a piece to block the attack.

examples.text:
The black rook attacks the white queen and the black queen attacks the white knight.

White can solve both problems in one move.
He interposes the knight between his queen and the black rook.

The knight is now out of reach of the queen and blocks the attack from the rook.

texts: Two of your pieces are attacked. Try to save both by interposing.
